svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of two walgit front-ends racing a conditional PUT against the gitwal.pb WAL index. First both front-ends upload their immutable WAL entry packs to the object store; the uploads never conflict. Then both PUT the index with If-Match e0 and the store accepts only one: front-end A wins and the index advances to e1, while front-end B receives 412 Precondition Failed. B re-fetches the e1 index, discards its conflicting append, re-appends its entry at the next sequence number, and retries with If-Match e1, which the store accepts — advancing the index to e2. Each WAL entry has a distinct color, and each index pointer is drawn in the color of the entry it references.
